items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: the staff rhythm section was former Les Brown people so when he got that show he was comfortable with them: Jack Sperling was the drummer and Rowley Bundock, who was with the original Glenn Miller band. Tony Rezey, the guitar player.

ctx.x: Well when I went on staff at NBC, Conrad Gozzo was still there and he was famous, one of the most famous lead trumpet players, number one in town for many years. And Joe Howard, the trombone player, was also the top rate trombone player. And the Carol Burnett show, when Peter Matz, who was from New York, became the band leader. I had known him when I was very young when he was going to UCLA I had done some work with him and when he was coming out here he called me and asked me if I’d like to come on that show.…
What did you think about the advent of rock & roll when it came on?
